title: Japanese-Style Flatbread with Delicate Dipping Sauce
description: A simple and delicious Japanese-inspired flatbread recipe served with a delicate dipping sauce. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: 3. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil.
4. In a separate bowl, mix together grated daikon and green onions.
5. Brush the flatbread pieces with the soy sauce mixture and season with salt.
6. Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes, or until crispy.
7. Meanwhile, prepare the delicate dipping sauce by whisking together soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil in a small bowl.
8. Serve the baked flatbread pieces with the delicate dipping sauce and garnish with grated daikon and green onions.
